question: As of 25 January 2027, how exposed are Midgard and Tolan to the end of the Orvan corridor agreement? Give a low and high range for wheat and maize imports.
event_verification_notes: Official government notices confirm that the one-year Corridor Agreement signed on 10 September 2025 expired on 10 September 2026 without a renewal or replacement arrangement signed. A previous report claiming renewal was issued an explicit correction.

event_citations.quote: The Corridor Agreement expired on 10 September 2026.
Talks on renewal ended without agreement. No replacement arrangement has been signed.
The agreement was signed on 10 September 2025 and ran for one year.

missing_data: Monthly maize trade statistics (volume and value) for the Orvan to Tolan route.
Aggregate quarterly volume/value for maize shipments through Ravik (only wheat data was found).
Quantitative monthly data for alternative Vanir maize exports and rail loadings.
corrections: ORV-0013 correction of ORV-0043: Raven Wire issued a correction confirming that the 9 September report claiming renewal of the Corridor Agreement was wrong and should not be relied upon.
ORV-0016 superseded of ORV-0003: The official notice of non-renewal on 10 September 2026 superseded the earlier 18 August notice expecting renewal.
